error.offline: govee-server isn't answering. Check that it's running, then reload the page.
error.outdated: This govee-server is older than Studio. Update it, restart it, then reload the page.
error.unreadable: Studio can't read the answer from govee-server. Update both to the same version.
mobile.title: Open Studio on a phone or tablet
mobile.scan: Scan the code with a phone or tablet on the same network.
mobile.off: Share Studio on this network, then scan the code with a phone or tablet.
mobile.warning: While sharing is on, any device on this network can control the lights.
mobile.fixed: govee-server listens on the network (--listen): any device on it can control the lights.
mobile.elsewhere: Sharing switches from the computer that runs govee-server.
settings.data.elsewhere: Export, import and reset work from the computer that runs govee-server, since the backup file can hold the API key.
data.confirm.title: Replace the current configuration?
data.confirm.body: The devices and settings in this file replace your current ones. You can restore them afterwards.
data.restore.hint: Bring back the devices and settings from before the last import
data.restore.title: Restore the previous configuration?
data.restore.body: Studio goes back to the devices and settings you had before the last import.
reset.title: Choose what to reset
reset.devices: Device list: names, modes, groups, rooms
reset.sure.title: Reset now?
reset.sure.body: These go back to their defaults, with no undo. Export a backup first to keep a copy.
small.tablet: This page opens on a tablet or a computer, where it has the room it needs.
small.desktop: This page opens on a computer. Widen the window to see it.
soon.library: Your presets and scenes in one place. A preset is a look. A scene plays looks on a timeline.
soon.live: Play your presets and scenes from a grid of pads, with a tap or a key.
soon.stage: Place the lights of a room in 3D, then compose scenes on a timeline, in time with the music.
home.welcome.title: Set up your lights
home.welcome.body: Find the lights on your network, name them and put them in rooms.
home.refresh: Refresh the status of every light
home.power.on: Turn back on the lights you turned off
panel.zones.help: Select segments, then pick a color: it paints them. With no segment selected, the color fills the whole light.
setup.title: Set up your lights
setup.new.none: Every light that answered is already set up.
setup.new.none.body: If a light is missing, check that LAN Control is on for it in the Govee Home app.
setup.none.body: Connect this computer to the same Wi-Fi as your lights, and turn on LAN Control for each light in the Govee Home app.
setup.rooms.none.body: Add your lights in the first step, then come back to put them in rooms.
setup.rooms.help: Drag a light onto a room, or click the light and then the room. A light can be in several rooms.
setup.rooms.name: Room name
setup.rooms.taken: A room already has this name.
setup.help: A light shows up here once LAN Control is on in the Govee Home app, and once it is on the same network as Studio.
help.label: Help
loading.label: Loading
light.offline: Offline: the light did not answer the scan
light.unknown: Not checked: the scan did not end
light.name: Name
